classification.difficultyReason: Combine the three purchases and apply the common 85% payable multiplier, or equivalently discount each item before summing.

content.prompt: A clothing store offers a $15\%$ discount on all its summer stock. How much will I need to pay in total if I buy a shirt with a marked price of $\$35$, a pair of shorts with a marked price of $\$25$, and a cotton sweater with a marked price of $\$50$?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Total marked price}&=35+25+50\\\text{Total marked price}&=\$110\\\text{Percentage payable}&=100\%-15\%\\\text{Percentage payable}&=85\%\\\text{Total payable}&=110\times0.85\\\text{Total payable}&=\$93.50\end{align*}$$
